about.metaDescription: The story behind the platform of the Greek Randonneuring community.
about.heroSubtitle: For those who know the road never ends soon enough.
about.webDesc: The web platform with a brevet calendar, community stats, race history, live tracking and rider profiles.
about.appDesc: The companion mobile app — rider history, live GPS tracking, brevet notifications and everything you need in the saddle.
about.section02P1Post: — is a form of long-distance cycling where the rider must complete a set distance within a time limit. It's not a race. There is no winner.
about.section02P2: There are only riders who reach the finish — and riders who try again.
about.section02P3Post: — and beyond — every brevet is a personal challenge against the route, the weather and yourself.
about.section03P1: The GRC Platform was born from the need of a community that deserves better tools. A place where every rider can find the season's brevets, track their history and see years of progress in the saddle.
about.section03P2: The platform doesn't belong to any company. It was built by a rider, for riders — with respect for the culture of Randonneuring and love for the Greek countryside we cross every year.
about.section03P3: You can find more information about brevet organization in Greece from the following organizations:
about.section05PPre: Every four years, hundreds of Greek riders aim for the sacred pilgrimage of Randonneuring — the
about.section05PPost: . 1,200 kilometers in 90 hours. Greece has already written its own history there.
about.contactIntro: For platform issues, bugs or suggestions:
about.contactNote: The platform is under continuous development. If something isn't working right — or if you have an idea that would make a rider's life easier — write to us.
about.footerQuoteTranslation: It takes time to go fast.
